turns.note: The landing page on a first visit, from the door in Solutions. Approved template B, the overnight arc, drawn from data.
Playbook §4: the daily automation as one production line. New block: nightshift (the invisible digital factory, the helping hand). Play the night.
Playbook §5, first 'tell me more'. New block: brain (the digital brain and glowing network). Pick a day or play the stay.
Playbook §5, second 'tell me more'. New block: agent (the autonomous thinker, the holographic figure, the helping hand). Step through.
Playbook §5, third 'tell me more': which records, from where. New block: sources (drawn switches). Flip them.
Playbook §7: one plain question about their systems, detail optional. New block: helper (the friendly desk helper).
The answer: billing and notes in one system. The sources board, set to their systems.
Beyond the playbook: the hand-over to Bed Management, each side checking the other. New block: relay.
The landing page the next morning, after the midnight refresh.
